name: Silvassa
registryBasis: The official Dadra and Nagar Haveli land-record portal identifies a Silvassa Mamlatdar Office contact and the UT revenue service links to the DNH Land Records / Bhu-Naksha service. The official DNH survey portal advertises certified maps, rural and urban boundary demarcation, and related cadastral services. This establishes a local land-record custodian and public service route, but not an anonymously queryable parcel-feature dataset.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The official DNH survey/map entrypoint https://dnh.nlrmp.in/psurveylive/Logininit.aspx returned HTTP 500 on an anonymous GET during this review. Search-indexed service text confirms cadastral-map and boundary services, but no public feature-service URL, safe native ID field, CRS, or geometry-only response was exposed. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, owner/address lookup, survey-number lookup, or private fields were used.
scopeLimits: Local custodian evidence is specific to Silvassa through the Mamlatdar Office contact and UT land-record service. The DNH portal's advertised service scope includes certified maps, demarcation, and cadastral-map publication, but public availability, citywide completeness, currentness, and anonymous machine-readable geometry were not verified. The municipal GIS property-survey tender is property-survey procurement evidence, not a parcel dataset.
remainingUncertainty: A public map/API route may exist behind the DNH portal or may require an interactive citizen workflow. Its current anonymous contract, schema, CRS, parcel identity, and Silvassa coverage remain unverified. Exact-point non-response is not treated as absence.

queries.query: Silvassa Dadra Nagar Haveli official cadastral parcel map GIS land records survey city
queries.result: Official results identified the DNH land-record/survey portal, a Silvassa Mamlatdar Office contact page, the UT revenue-service page, a DILRMP status page, and a Silvassa Municipal Council GIS property-survey notice. The official survey portal advertised certified-map and boundary-demarcation services, but no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint or safe schema was verified.

queries.query: सिलवासा दादरा नगर हवेली आधिकारिक भू-अभिलेख नक्शा जमीन सर्वेक्षण

The linked DNH service is the same official land-record/survey route; its public service description was visible in search results, but its anonymous map entrypoint returned HTTP 500 and exposed no safe parcel geometry response.

officialSources.observation: Official DNH land-record portal contact page names Mamlatdar Office, Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, with a public office telephone number. This is local custodian evidence, not parcel geometry evidence.
Official UT revenue page links DNH Bhu-Naksha and DNH land records. The linked portal is the relevant first-party map/service route.

Official DNH survey portal search result advertises certified maps, rural/urban boundary demarcation, and land subdivision/amalgamation services. Anonymous direct GET returned HTTP 500; no schema or geometry was obtained.
Official UT notice records a Silvassa Municipal Council GIS-based property survey procurement. It does not publish a parcel layer or establish legal cadastral coverage.
Official national DILRMP status result reports digitization/geo-reference statistics for the UT/tehsil context, but it is aggregate program status, not an anonymous Silvassa parcel service.
